name: Voice of the Magister (Achievement)
body:
You have mastered the ancient art of glossolalia. Your spoken spells resonate with that power.

Prerequisite: You must use a spellbook to prepare spells. Cast 35 different spells that have verbal components.

Benefit: Add +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells with a verbal component. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Spell Focus and Greater Spell Focus.
